sisi.depan: Across the arena, the splintered teak frame of a collapsed grand hall rises from the snow, its multi-tiered joglo roof caved in, and its wide, empty main entrance choked with frozen debris.
sisi.kanan: Toppled and broken carved stone pillars from a collapsed covered colonnade lie in a jagged line, their intricate floral carvings barely visible under a thick blanket of ice.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, the dark silhouettes of dead, skeletal trees stand on a distant, snow-covered ridgeline.
sisi.kiri: A partially standing wall of a ruined archive building features shattered geometric krawangan latticework in its window openings, with heavy snow piled against its base.

tengah: A scorched, hexagonal arena with cracked basalt floor tiles and shattered, ice-encrusted low walls is half-buried in deep snow drifts.
atas: A starless, perpetually overcast sky is choked with dark grey snow clouds, offering no light.
